titleEn: Proof of opt-in for a customer / opt-out list export

en: Meta asked for proof of consent

steps: Owner lists per customer when and how consent was given (with the wording) and when someone opted out
Paged 200 at a time, CSV with ?format=csv; every download is audited by count
gaps: No download button on the Contacts screen yet: the assistant answers the counts; the file is the route with ?format=csv
assistantNote: The assistant answers the counts only; the per-customer list (phone numbers) is the owner download, never read into the chat.
